## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `ci` — pipeline or automation
- [ ] `chore` — maintenance or dependencies
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs are updated.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, account IDs or personal data are included.
- [ ] Security impact is described below.
- [ ] Cost impact is described below.
- [ ] Rollback plan is described below.
- [ ] The change is limited to the current phase.
